raw: PTGS2 encodes Prostaglandin G/H synthase 2, which is associated with 65 biological processes according to Pharos target-gene mapping and Gene Ontology annotation. Curated examples include NAD biosynthesis via nicotinamide riboside salvage pathway [1], aging [2], angiogenesis [3], inflammatory response [19], cyclooxygenase pathway [14], and embryo implantation [17]. All listed sources are curated; no statistical, text-mined, or predicted evidence is shown. Line [18] (hair cycle) was pruned and lacks row support. The lines do not indicate effect size, directionality, tissue specificity, or experimental validation beyond the curated annotations.
